standfirst: SRLV holds maedi-visna virus of sheep and caprine arthritis-encephalitis virus of goats, which are one continuum rather than two clean species. Five features, all with profiles — including tat, which in this genus is not what its name suggests.

modules.SRLV: SRLV tat is a single-exon protein, also published as S, and it was MEASURED collinear by tblastn of each deposited protein against its own genome rather than assumed spliced from the HIV-1 layout. It therefore gets a PSSM and a copy_num like any other feature. EIAV tat, in the sister module, is genuinely spliced and gets neither.

gaps: No declared feature lacks a profile. rev appears in the vocabulary and bins to its own key, but the module does not declare it: it is spliced, and nothing here calls spliced features.
